items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source (Customer Account Takeover)
items.summary: This update resolves a critical incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVE-2026-71362) that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to switch a customer session to another customer account and escalate privileges. Threat actors are attempting to exploit this vulnerability in the wild.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting vulnerability in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This high-severity vulnerability could result in arbitrary code execution and requires authentication and administrator privileges for exploitation.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting vulnerability in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This high-severity vulnerability could result in arbitrary code execution and requires authentication but not administrator privileges for exploitation.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce B2B
items.summary: This high-severity vulnerability could enable a security-feature bypass and requires authentication but not administrator privileges for exploitation.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This high-severity vulnerability could enable a security-feature bypass and requires neither authentication nor administrator privileges for exploitation.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including issues that could lead to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Unauthenticated file upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, leading to remote code execution. The vulnerability has a CVSS score of 9.3, and attacks were observed the same day the patch was released.

items.title: Critical vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer for Magento
items.summary: Sansec discovered an unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer, a full-page cache extension, which can lead to remote code execution with a CVSS rating of 9.8. Mirasvit released a patched version (1.11.12) on May 25, 2026.

items.title: Adobe Commerce Auth Bypass Vulnerability
items.summary: This Incorrect Authorization vulnerability allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to bypass security checks and gain unauthorized write access to the affected application. The flaw has a CVSS 3.1 base score of 7.5.

items.title: Unrestricted file upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce REST API
items.summary: Sansec discovered a critical flaw in Magento's REST API that lets unauthenticated attackers upload executable files to any store using a polyglot to bypass validation. Adobe released a fix in Magento 2.4.9 around May 12, 2026, but older supported versions remain vulnerable without an isolated patch.
